description:
Overview


Reporting to the Sr. Manager of Engineering, this is an ideal opportunity to step into a challenging role directly impacting the security of our nation. As we expand our Air Compressor offerings, Curtiss-Wright is looking for an experienced air compressor and rotating machinery design engineer who can help us lead cutting edge air compressor technology into the next generation of Navy vessels.


Location


Remote (preferred Bethlehem, PA)


Salary


$127,100 to $150,000 per year. Note: This salary range is a general guideline for a Pennsylvania-based position. Final offer is contingent on qualifications, experience, scope of work, and market considerations.


Benefits



  • Paid Time Off

  • 401K with Employer Match and Profit Sharing

  • Health and Wellness Benefits

  • Learning and Development Opportunities

  • Referral Program

  • Competitive Pay

  • Recognition

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Inclusive & Supportive Culture


Your Challenge


Direct or perform the design and development of reciprocating and centrifugal compressor products, including development and management of project work plans and the project execution to satisfy technical, cost, and schedule objectives.


Responsibilities



  • Coordinate with other engineering disciplines and other departments to develop overall compressor system solutions

  • Manage the overall development costs as well as the costs of the resulting products

  • Define and manage product design requirements in accordance with internal and contract requirements

  • Develop engineering models and perform analyses to support the design of the compressor products

  • Lead project engineering team meetings with internal resources, customers and the US Navy

  • Prepare procedures, and train and support manufacturing technicians to ensure the products are manufactured, assembled and tested correctly

  • Develop tooling and prepare engineering drawings and specifications to support the manufacture and test of the products including the disposition of non-conformances that occur

  • Prepare and submit test procedures, reports, operating guidelines, maintenance plans and other software deliverables

  • Analyze test results to confirm product performance compliance, design adequacy, and to identify areas for product improvement

  • Support the entire product life-cycle including field support, trouble-shooting, repair and operator support

  • Implement product improvement programs to minimize cost, improve performance, improve reliability and promote standardization

  • Support the development of proposals including the review of contracts and specifications

  • Maintain effective customer communications, ensuring that all customer requirements are addressed effectively

  • Communicate project progress, issues, and/or resolution options to project team members, customers and internal management

  • Other opportunities within the business for career growth as time permits


Qualifications



  • Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain security clearances

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering (Mechanical preferred) with minimum 7 years' experience in the reciprocating or centrifugal compressor industry

  • Project management or project leadership while working in a team environment preferred

  • Material processing knowledge (Machining and Fabrication)

  • Knowledge of Industry Standards (Military, ASTM, SAE, etc)

  • Proficiency with a solid modeling program (SolidWorks preferred)

  • FEA experience a plus

  • Understanding of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T)

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

  • Excellent organization, communication (written and oral), and presentation skills

  • Self-starter, motivated, and action-oriented individual able to excel in an environment with individual accountability


Travel


  • 10% or less

Industries

Who We Are


Curtiss-Wright Engineered Pump Division (EPD) and its predecessor companies have been providing naval and maritime technological expertise since 1847. EPD\'s pumps go to the heart of the systems that enable the Navy\'s ships and submarines to protect our nation. EPD is the leading supplier of mission-critical pumps for the U.S. Navy\'s Ford & Nimitz Class aircraft carriers and Virginia Class submarines, as well as the Navy\'s next-generation Columbia Class submarine. title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
Overview


Join to apply for the Enterprise Account Executive role at Canonical .


This is a general track role, hiring for opportunities across all levels of seniority in our Sales Teams. Apply if you believe you possess outstanding revenue generating experience from the Technology industry.


Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors. We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.


Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.


Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.


We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.


In building our sales team, we look for five things:



  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems

  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence

  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes

  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions

  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers


Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.


The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.


Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.


What your day will look like



  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory

  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting

  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events

  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets

  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives

  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle

  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers' business problems

  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities

  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce

  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers


What we are looking for in you



  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science

  • Experience of open source technology and solutions

  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up

  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution

  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins

  • Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team

  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market

  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events


Additional Skills Of Interest



  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech

  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events


What we offer you


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.



  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

  • Annual compensation review

  • Recognition rewards

  • Annual holiday leave

  • Maternity and paternity leave

  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events


About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.


Canonical is an equal opportunity employer


We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Guided by our commitment to excellence and collaboration, we aim to redefine the landscape of event technology, setting new standards for engagement, accessibility, and impact.

We believe that by embracing a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and viewpoints, we can truly understand and cater to the needs of our global community of event organizers and participants.

Our full remote opportunities empower our team to thrive, no matter where they are in the world, fostering a culture of flexibility and inclusion.

What you will be doing?

  • Build efficient and robust data pipelines for large volumes of data, from internal databases and SaaS applications, using Fivetran, Airbyte or Python.
  • Develop and optimize transformation data models using Redshift, Dbt, Dagster and other tools.
  • Monitor and maintain our cloud data warehouse (Redshift) with timely and quality data.
  • Set and ensure data engineering standards as part of the department goals.
  • Collaborate with other teams to ensure data engineering needs/requests are addressed.
  • Create and maintain documentations.

What you should have?

  • 5+ years hands-on experience deploying code in production.
  • At least 2 years of exp with DBT with hands-on experience delivering transformation pipelines with Dbt.
  • Demonstrably deep understanding of SQL and data warehouse.
  • Hands-on experience implementing ETL.
  • Experience working with Python.
  • Experience working with a workflow orchestrator (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Kestra, …)
  • At least 4 years of exp with a cloud data warehouse
  • Fluency in English.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Dagster.
  • Experience with data vizualisation tools (e.g Tableau).
  • Knowledge in Infra toolchain (e.g Docker, Terraform, Helm).

Swapcard’s Interview process

1. Screening Interview with a recruiter from our people team.

2. A remote exercise to demonstrate and assess your skills.

3. Manager review with your future reporting manager

4. Leadership review with one of our department leaders

5. Reference check conducted by our people team

6. Offer

Swapcard's Values

Human : At Swapcard, being human means fostering empathy, openness, and diversity to create a caring and collaborative community. We’re driven by a strong team spirit and a shared goal of building meaningful connections—both through our product and within our team.

Resilient : We embrace challenges with optimism, creativity, and adaptability, constantly seeking innovative solutions and opportunities for growth.

Ownership: At Swapcard, we take responsibility and are accountable for our actions, driving success through initiative, trust, and accountability. True ownership means more than just completing tasks; it's about being proactive, investing ourselves fully in the outcomes, and fostering a culture of trust.

  • Open-minded culture that appreciates differences

Optional requirements

Tech stack

  • Snowflake for data warehousing.

  • Tableau for BI and reporting.

  • Google Ad Manager integration is underway; experience with this tool is a plus.

  • Existing data lake architecture includes raw, structured, and curated zones.

  • Preference for data marts that plug into Tableau's relationship system — not heavily SQL-based dashboards.

What you'll do

  • Thrive in an inclusive environment that prioritizes continuous learning, innovation, and ethical AI standards.

title: Inside Sales Representative   | Wellness Leads | Video Calls – LATAM
description:
Company Overview: Our client is on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives through proactive, personalized care. They’re building a high-touch, fully virtual wellness experience that empowers individuals to take control of their health—and they’re growing fast.

To support that growth, they’re looking for an experienced sales professional based in LATAM to join their mission-driven wellness team. In this role, you’ll connect with qualified inbound leads , guide them through short video calls, and book them for full consultations with our wellness advisors.

This is a remote, full-time, target-driven position where your ability to build trust, follow up, and close appointments will directly impact our clients’ health journeys.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct short video calls with warm leads to understand their needs
  • Qualify leads based on specific criteria
  • Book consultations for their wellness advisors
  • Follow up consistently via text, email, and CRM
  • Keep CRM records accurate and up to date
  • Follow up consistently with unbooked leads or those needing more info
  • Work closely with the sales team to improve the lead journey

You’ll be the first real human contact for many of their leads. These are people who are already interested, you’re not cold calling. Your job is to welcome them, qualify them, and book the next step in their journey.

You’ll engage leads via short video calls, email, and SMS. You’ll answer their questions, guide them toward clarity, and ensure no good lead slips through the cracks. You’ll need to be professional, organized, and confident on camera.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years in sales, appointment setting, or admissions (B2C preferred)
  • Proven track record of hitting booking or sales targets
  • Excellent spoken and written English (light accent preferred for U.S. audiences)
  • Confident and professional on live video calls
  • Based in LATAM with 3–5 hours U.S. timezone overlap
  • Comfortable with CRM tools, scheduling platforms, and messaging apps
  • Bonus if you have: Experience in health, wellness, or education services
  • Background in high-touch, premium client interactions

What You Get

  • 100% remote work
  • Flexible hours, with a preference for some U.S. timezone overlap
  • Competitive pay
  • The chance to help people improve their health, daily

Target Start Date: September

Location: LATAM only

If you’re a sales pro who thrives on meaningful conversations and hitting goals, we’d love to meet you. Apply now and help us change the way people approach health and wellness.

title: Database Administration Engineer (Remote)
description:
APM Terminals – Global DBA Engineer

Locations: Itajai, Pecem, Suape Brazil (remote flexibility)

Job classification: 3

Purpose
APM Terminals, a global leader in port and terminal operations and part of the A.P. Moller-Maersk Group, is committed to delivering world-class container handling, logistics solutions, and maritime services. With operations in over 70 countries, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence, all while driving sustainable growth and making a positive impact on communities worldwide.

At APM Terminals, we offer exceptional opportunities for personal and professional development in a diverse and inclusive environment. Join us as we shape the future of global trade and redefine industry standards.

The Global DBA Engineer role is responsible for the performance, integrity, security, and availability of databases within the organization. The role encompasses both strategic and operational duties, including the efficient storage of data, maintaining access reliability, and protection against data loss or unauthorized access. The DBA will collaborate closely with terminal and regional infrastructure teams to uphold current standards, implement robust backup and recovery policies, and carry out database tuning and performance monitoring to support business continuity and system optimization.

Responsibilities

  • We are looking for DBA with experience mainly in SQL-Server.
  • Install and maintain the performance of database servers.
  • Install and maintain high-availability scenarios (AON, replication).
  • Knowledge of database security, backup and recovery, and performance monitoring standards.
  • Develop processes for optimizing database security.
  • Set and maintain database standards.
  • Manage database access.
  • Performance tuning of database systems.
  • Install, upgrade, and manage database applications.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot database errors.
  • Triage reported issues to accurately identify, escalate, and respond to urgent or critical matters in support of terminal operations.
  • Identify root causes of outages and issues and prepare plans for permanent changes to eliminate/reduce chronic issues or establish SOPs for resolution by ‘shift left’ resources.
  • Recommend and implement emerging database technologies.
  • Create and manage database reports, visualizations, and dashboards.
  • Create automation for repeating database tasks.
  • Work with the Global N4 Migration Team on all N4 upgrades.
  • Document implementation and deployment plans.
  • Be available for on-call support as needed.
  • Valuable Oracle DBA experience.
  • In cooperation with TOS app, deliver 24x7x365 (follow the sun) support to end users and system consumers N4 and related applications. Expand support model to all locations globally.

The above outlined responsibilities are not exhaustive, and you may be required to carry out other tasks that are appropriate to your role in addition to these.

Critical Qualifications/Skills/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field preferred
  • Over three years of experience in database administration, information technology, database architecture, or a related field
  • MCSE/MCSA certifications preferred
  • Experience with Windows Server environments preferred
  • Good communication skills
  • Fluent in English; Spanish is valuable.
  • Adaptable to different cultures.
  • Willingness and availability to travel.

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing

title: Tech Lead
description:
Resumo

Como a maior empresa de Educação Básica do Brasil, nos cercamos de pessoas excepcionais, entusiasmadas e comprometidas com a missão de transformar vidas e o Brasil por meio da educação.

Buscamos ser a referência no mundo em tecnologia para educação. Procuramos pessoas antenadas e apaixonadas por desenvolvimento de software, ávidas por conhecimento, que gostem de inovar, e que sejam proativas e criativas na busca das melhores soluções para nossas escolas, alunos, professores e funcionários.

Na função de Tech Lead de uma de nossas Squads, esperamos que você possua uma forte bagagem técnica e perfil colaborativo, capaz de treinar e liderar, influenciar decisões técnicas e de negócio, e contribuir ativamente para o desenvolvimento profissional do time. Valorizamos quem alia excelência técnica a uma escuta ativa e visão estratégica.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar o time técnico – Desenvolvedores, QAs e Suporte Técnico – de uma Squad, garantindo uma cultura de excelência de entrega em termos de prazos e qualidade;
  • Atuar com maestria em todo ciclo de vida de um projeto de software: entendimento das necessidades de negócio, refinamentos técnicos, definição de arquitetura, delivery, testes automatizados, integração contínua, deploy contínuo;
  • Conduzir a definição e evolução do roadmap e débitos técnicos da equipe;
  • Trabalhar com a equipe de Produto e Design para entender as necessidades do negócio, antecipando as mudanças para proporcionar uma experiência incrível ao usuário, garantindo assim a entrega de sistemas intuitivos, bonitos e com ótima usabilidade;
  • Conduzir revisões de código, promover a evolução contínua da arquitetura e garantir a manutenção de padrões organizacionais;
  • Participar ativamente de rituais, workshops, reuniões de alinhamento e momentos de formação técnica com o time;
  • Ser um agente de cultura e desenvolvimento, promovendo autonomia, aprendizado contínuo e colaboração;
  • Ser um agente no uso de IA em todas as funções da equipe;
  • Transmitir seus conhecimentos para o time de forma constante, contribuindo para o crescimento técnico de toda equipe.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência de no mínimo 3 anos liderando times de desenvolvimento;
  • Que seja uma pessoa proativa, enfrentando desafios com otimismo;
  • Que seja incansável na busca da alta performance da equipe, tanto em termos de compromissos/prazos quanto em termos de qualidade de excelência;
  • Vasta experiência em desenvolvimento, especificamente com HTML/CSS/Javascript, .NET, Angular;
  • Domínio das melhores práticas em qualidade de desenvolvimento, especificamente Design Patterns, S.O.L.I.D e Testes Unitários/API/Automatizados;
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais e não relacionais, performance e estratégias de uso;
  • Experiência com DevOps, Continuous Delivery Pipeline (CI, CD, Containers, Dynamic Environment Configuration);
  • Experiência no uso de alguma ferramenta de IA (ex. Cursor, Github Copilot).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com observabilidade (ex. Datadog, CloudWatch, Kibana, etc);
  • Terraform/Docker;
  • Já tenha trabalhado com nuvens públicas (AWS, Azure, etc);
  • Experiência com Microserviços.

Características desejadas

  • Seja antenado e apaixonado por desenvolvimento de software;
  • Seja ávido por conhecimento;
  • Tenha proatividade;
  • Trabalhe bem em equipe, que goste de aprender, ensinar e ajudar o time;

title: Sr. Market Development Representative (MDR)
description:
Signifyd is seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented MDR to join our go-to-market function. In this crucial role, you will be instrumental in creating and progressing net new sales opportunities in our highest tier segment. You will report to the Senior Manager of Market Development as part of the broader NORAM business unit. You will support our key stakeholders - our sellers, known as Strategic Ecommerce Partners - in crafting and executing break-in strategies and ensuring the early stage pipeline has enough support to progress towards booking. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute directly to our strategic goals, be compensated for KPIs and bookings, but not be solely responsible for closing.

Responsibilities

  • Targeted Business Development Outreach:
    • Identify and research potential high-value target accounts aligned with our strategic objectives based on internal and external signals, and intent (6Sense, LinkedIn SalesNav, company and industry research).
    • Execute targeted outreach through cold calls, emails, LinkedIn Messages, event invites, and other methods of prospecting.
    • Individually source, book and kick off initial discovery calls which become demand-gen opportunities as a key performance metric.
    • Progress demand generation opportunities to 'sales qualified opportunities' based on stated criteria, meeting monthly targets.
    • Develop and share engagement plans on high intent or focus accounts which includes contact mapping and break-in strategy for the senior sellers and executive leadership.
    • Leverage the entirety of the marketing function (e.g. campaigns, social selling, networking, virtual and in-person events, ABM motions) to generate qualified opportunities and progress the existing pipeline.
    • Although optional, attendance at industry events can be a key driver of understanding the dynamic of eCommerce and building relationships.
  • Sales Pipeline Management:
    • Collaborate closely with 2-3 Strategic Ecommerce Partners to manage and nurture all existing sales opportunities, scheduling follow up meetings as well.
    • Maintain organizational rigor and ownership on opportunity progression by managing and coordinating next steps and long term nurture (12+ months) where opportunities are dependent on prospects’ tech roadmap or upcoming renewals.
    • Compile internal collateral for tailored presentations and other relevant materials in collaboration with sales, marketing, partnerships and executive leadership.
    • Maintain meticulous records of deal status, activities, ownership of action items and key milestones within the CRM.
  • Collaboration and Development:
    • Proactively collaborate and leverage Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Partnerships and executives to drive results and optimize the sales process.
    • Quickly gain a fundamental understanding of our key value propositions and ecommerce and fraud trends in order to craft powerful and personalized stories.
    • Provide regular updates on outreach activities, lead generation metrics, and deal progression status to peers and executive leadership.
    • Contribute to the development and refinement of our sales strategies, processes and best practices.
    • Stay up-to-date on industry trends, competitive landscape, and best practices in sales development and deal management; uncover gaps and communicate those internally.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in sales development, business development, account management or similar role at an enterprise or higher level. Understanding of ecommerce, payments or fraud is a plus.
  • Proven track record of successfully generating qualified leads through proactive outreach and following up on intent; you know your process and can apply it.
  • Understanding of longer term deal cycles and how opportunities progress through a sales pipeline.
  • High energy, proactivity, tenacity and proficiency with written/verbal communication skills, with an ability to craft compelling and succinct messaging; AI familiarity is a plus.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn SalesNav).
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with a keen attention to detail.

Job Description

The new team member, working within the Financial Reporting team, will play a key role in supporting the evolution of financial reporting in a challenging and stimulating environment. You will help bridge the gap between finance and BI. Our primary objective is to assist the business in making decisions based on data, with a particular emphasis on producing reports as the primary and most reliable source of information.

A team of 12 experts provides support to various departments, including marketing, sales, customer success, finance, and people experience, for both short-term and long-term projects. Collaborating closely with stakeholders, we strive to develop reports, analyses, models, and recommendations that enable us to gain a deep understanding of how we can enhance the satisfaction of both doctors and patients.

You will be an integral part of the Financial Reporting team, working closely with the Data Analytics team to support business decisions based on data.

How would you be impacting our mission

  • Financial Reporting and Analysis: Track key financial metrics and KPIs, ensuring they align with organizational goals; Develop and maintain comprehensive financial dashboards using advanced BI tools; Provide detailed insights into financial performance, trends, and variances; Provide insights for long-term strategic decisions.
  • Data Management and Integration: Ensure accurate and timely collection of financial data from systems like Oracle NetSuite; Integrate data from multiple sources for a unified financial view.
  • Performance Measurement: Analyze profitability and cost efficiency to identify improvement areas.
  • Regulatory and Compliance Reporting: Support audits and regulatory documentation.
  • Automation and Process Improvement: Automate repetitive financial tasks to improve efficiency; Implement process improvements to reduce manual efforts and errors.
  • Enhanced Reporting and Visualization: Utilize BI tools like Tableau for dynamic, interactive reports and dashboards; Enhance report quality and accessibility beyond traditional spreadsheets.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Economics, Statistics, Econometrics or a related field.
  • Demonstrable experience in using SQL to derive actionable insights, either in commercial or academic setting (must have).
  • Knowledge of Python/R and desire to expand your knowledge.
  • Experience with statistical modeling and descriptive statistics.
  • Experience in partnership with internal stakeholders.
  • Experience in leading and executing end-to-end BI projects.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills in English; proficiency in other languages such as German, Spanish, and Italian is a plus.
  • Ability to gather, organize, analyze, and report large volumes of financial data with speed and accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to provide high-quality work efficiently.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to adapt and work in a quickly changing environment, managing competing demands.

Bonus Points

  • Master's degree in Economics, Statistics, Econometrics or a related field.
  • Ability to examine technical topics through a business lens.
  • Openness to cooperating with many teams in different countries.
  • Desire to see instant effects of your work.
  • Knowledge of ERP finance applications (Oracle, NetSuite, SAP).
  • Relevant experience in accounting and financial reporting.

Additional Information

What to Expect from Our Hiring Process

Role

We like to keep things transparent and efficient. Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

  • Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Acquisition Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

  • Focus on results – we’re here to make an impact.
  • Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.
  • Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. title: Enterprise Account Executive - Spanish speaker
description:
Join to apply for the Enterprise Account Executive - Spanish speaker role at Canonical

1 month ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Enterprise Account Executive - Spanish speaker role at Canonical

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.
We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.
Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.
Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.
In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers
Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.
The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.
Location: This role can be based in Americas and the assigned territory will be Chile. Being based in Chile is therefore preferable.
What your day will look like
  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers' business problems
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
  • Experience of open source technology and solutions
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins
  • Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as Spanish for your target market
  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events
Additional Skills Of Interest
  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

…work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux-based infrastructure and applications, covering all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications large enterprise customers run.
This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself.
You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.
Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.
The role entails

  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical's Field, Support and product engineering teams

  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities

  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep-dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice-to-have skills
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about any of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD,Postgresql, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

title: Program Delivery and Business Development Manager - Dual-Use Robotics
description:
Overview


FLX Solutions is redefining how critical infrastructure is inspected and maintained using advanced robotic systems that enhance mission readiness and safety. Our patented FLX BOT solves one of the toughest challenges in maintenance: reaching the “last meter” in complex environments. It is a modular, collaborative, handheld articulating snake-like robotic platform, and is already in use in the U.S. Navy, Air Force, and shipbuilders with expanding applications in industrial, transit, and construction sectors.


The FLX BOT is 1" in diameter and can navigate confined or hazardous spaces on ships, bases, and aircraft. Its modular design includes interchangeable links with advanced cameras and sensors for obstacle avoidance, and its patented design offers greater articulation, lighter weight, and a smaller footprint than competing robots at a fraction of the cost. Operated by a single technician via handheld control or extension pole, it reduces labor and improves safety.


FLX Solutions has completed and launched pilots with the U.S. Air Force (D2P2 focused on aircraft wing fuel tank inspections at Robins AFB), U.S. Navy (corrosion assessment, 3D tank mapping), and a major DoD Prime. In paid Navy pilots, the FLX BOT reduced inspection times by up to 90% while eliminating the need for teardowns or confined space entry. FLX Solutions has 3 FLX BOTs deployed at the largest shipbuilder for the Navy, and a 1-year pilot with the NYC Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA).


The Opportunity: FLX Solutions is at a key inflection point: we have several high-value programs underway and are looking for a proven leader who can secure new contracts and successfully deliver them to completion. Your mission: capitalize on our momentum and scale our success. The FLX BOT technology is already proven and the market is responding. We have a high-confidence pipeline of over $18M including an upcoming large pilot order from the Navy. And this is just the beginning. We are looking for a proven operator to take ownership of critical programs and business development efforts. This is an experienced player role, not a management-only position (yet). While this role has a clear path to building and leading a team as we grow, your initial focus will be on rolling up your sleeves and personally driving. You\'ll work at the intersection of business development, program management, and operations, with the autonomy to take a customer relationship from initial contact to successful program delivery. You will partner directly with the CEO on capture strategy and customer engagement, and with our technical teams to ensure what we sell is what we deliver. The role also involves jumping into whatever business operations tasks are needed to grow the company and complete projects ranging from negotiating a defense contract to refining internal processes, or jumping on a late-night call with a customer in the middle of a trial. We need someone who has been on the startup journey before and helped grow a hardware company from seed stage through commercialization and scale, and has experienced the problems we’re solving first-hand.



What You’ll Do



Business Development and Program Acquisition



  • Identify, pursue, and close new contracts in defense and commercial markets, with an initial focus on high-potential opportunities already in the pipeline

  • Work directly with the CEO on capture strategy, proposal development, and customer engagement

  • Build trusted relationships with decision-makers at government agencies, prime contractors, and industrial partners

  • Lead the proposal and capture process end-to-end: lead the preparation of proposals, RFP responses, and competitive bids from end-to-end: shaping requirements, identifying teaming opportunities, selecting acquisition pathways (BAAs, CSOs, IDIQs, etc.), and submitting winning proposals



Program Leadership and Delivery



  • Serve as the Program Lead for our defense accounts, starting with the execution and multi-site deployment for the U.S. Navy and Air Force programs

  • Act as the primary customer interface for dual-use programs, managing scope, schedule, and budget to ensure all commitments are met

  • Partner with our hardware and software teams to manage technical requirements, identify risks, and guarantee what we sell is what we deliver



Operational Leadership



  • Establish and refine program management processes that can scale with the company

  • Track KPIs for program health, customer satisfaction, and revenue performance

  • Take on diverse business operations tasks that support company growth and program success as an early member of a growing team



Strategic Contribution



  • Work with leadership on market opportunities, partnerships, and program prioritization

  • Represent FLX at customer sites, program reviews, trade shows, conferences, and industry networking events

  • Identify new growth opportunities for business and technology expansion



You Are



  • Experienced in both winning and managing complex programs in defense, aerospace, robotics, and/or other dual-use technology sectors

  • Skilled at working at the intersection of business development, program management, and operations

  • Deeply familiar with DoD procurement processes and effective at building strong customer relationships with government agencies, primes, and dual-use customers

  • Comfortable in a startup environment, able to switch between high-level strategy and hands-on execution

  • Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple high-value projects at the same time

  • Understanding of the business constraints in early stage companies and able to work within them

  • A startup veteran experienced in helping grow startups from seed stage to full commercialization and scaling operations



Qualifications


Required



  • 5-8+ years in program management, business development, or operations in relevant industries

  • Startup or scaling-company experience in hardware or robotics

  • Proven ability to secure and deliver multi-million-dollar programs including DoD acquisition and contracting

  • Established network in Navy, Air Force, shipbuilding, or major industrial maintenance programs

  • U.S. citizenship (due to DoD requirements)

  • Willingness to travel for customer meetings, pilots, and events

  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills

  • Experience and proficiency with modern tools including AI tools, CRMs, and Project Management tools (e.g. ClickUp)



Preferred



  • Firsthand DoD operational experience, particularly as a Veteran of the U.S. Navy or U.S. Air Force (e.g., Engineering Duty Officer)

  • Have led/been involved in the successful fundraising of capital at an early stage dual-use startup

  • Technical background

  • PMP certification or equivalent project management experience



Company Core Values



  • Do what you say, say what you do

  • We all make mistakes; it is what we do afterwards that defines us

  • Treat all with respect. Period.

  • Leave a situation better than you found it

  • Just because something has always been done a certain way, doesn’t mean it has to be done that way in the future



Compensation and Location



  • Salary: Competitive for an early-stage company, with significant performance-based increases tied directly to the programs you deliver and expand

  • Equity: A meaningful, early-stage equity grant. You will be a critical part of our success, and your compensation will reflect that.

  • Location: Remote-friendly. However, we have a strong preference for candidates in a key defense or technology hub (DC area, San Diego, Norfolk, Seattle, Bay Area, NYC) or near our Bethlehem, PA HQ, to enhance collaboration with our team and customers.

  • Flexibility: Will adapt role and package for the right candidate

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)

description:
• We’re looking for individuals with hands-on startup and SaaS experience who thrive in fast-paced, product-driven environments.
  • While we value diverse backgrounds, applicants whose experience is exclusively within consulting firms may not be the best fit for this role.
  • Please submit your resume in English to ensure a smooth review process.

---

This is an opportunity to build something truly big. You will have a direct impact on the industry and the way people travel, connect, and discover the world. That is the kind of work you can expect at Enso Connect.

What we do

Enso Connect is a guest experience platform for vacation rentals and boutique hotels that seamlessly plugs into property management systems to personalize and monetize interactions throughout the entire guest journey. From AI-driven messaging and contactless check-in to upsells and verification, we are the "Zapier of hospitality" - connecting all the tools you already love while increasing profit per guest.

We are a well-funded startup with strong product-market fit and excellent sales momentum. We are expanding rapidly and need to scale our engineering team. Our current tech team is around 12 people. We operate as a true meritocracy where the best ideas win regardless of seniority. We have an energetic culture that moves fast. Every engineer has a voice in technical and product decisions.

You will be joining our engineering team to help build this mission-critical system that processes thousands of bookings daily for hospitality businesses worldwide. This is a full-time remote position (38-40 hrs/week) that requires high autonomy and self-direction, with significant ownership over your work and direct connection to business impact and clients. We require overlap of at least 3 hours with EST business hours (9 AM - 5 PM EST). On rare occasions, system outages may require attention outside of regular business hours.

Who You Are

As a full stack software developer, you will be instrumental in the architecture, design, development, delivery and support of key features and integrations. You will work closely with our development team throughout the entire development lifecycle to solve diverse business & technical challenges.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Gathering requirements & feedback from stakeholders (sales, client success, product) to address business & technical challenges
  • Architecting & scoping solutions that strike the right balance between quality and velocity
  • Build and maintain scalable features & improvements end to end, including testing & deployment
  • Managing your tasks & communicating changes in your own timelines pro-actively
  • Monitoring your work post-deploy to ensure a high level of quality and positive feedback from users
  • Collaborate on architecture decisions for a clean and easy to maintain system
  • Participating in design sessions and code reviews with peers to elevate the quality of engineering across the organization

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience building and maintaining web applications, ideally with a strong backend focus.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, event-driven systems, and RESTful APIs.
  • Comfortable designing and implementing features end-to-end, including architecture, infrastructure, frontend/backend logic, testing, and deployment.
  • Experience working in a cloud-native environment, ideally with AWS Lambda, SQS/SNS, API Gateway, OpenSearch, and serverless Framework.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD workflows, testing (unit, integration), and monitoring tools like DataDog or CloudWatch.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. You enjoy working closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and support teams.
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Cursor, etc) to accelerate development and improve engineering workflows.

Nice To Haves

  • Experience creating and modifying end to end integrations using API specifications and UX guidelines.
  • Serverless infrastructure experience, specifically AWS & FaaS
  • Experience working at startups / Proptech
  • Experience working directly with the customer / end user to triage problems.
  • Bonus if you are available for occasional in-person work in downtown Toronto, but you would be required to have a overlap of at least 3 hours with EST business hours.

Why Us?

  • We are a dynamic and innovative company that is dedicated to making a positive impact in the hospitality industry. Our team is made up of passionate and dedicated individuals who are committed to driving change and pushing boundaries. We offer a collaborative and dynamic work environment that encourages creativity and growth.
  • Our company is known for its industry-leading technology
  • By joining us you will have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects, be part of a culture that values your contributions and have access to ample resources and training to help you achieve your professional goals.

  • Unlimited Vacation : As long as key deliverables are met, you have unlimited time off
  • Employee Stock Options : Option for ESOP participation as part of compensation plan
  • Remote-First Culture : Fully remote with flexible hours (within EST overlap requirements)
  • Direct Impact : Your work directly affects business outcomes and client success
  • Growth Opportunities : Rapid company growth means expanded responsibilities and career advancement

Enso Connect is committed to creating a diverse environment and is an equal-opportunity employer. Enso Connect does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or disability status.

Our Mission

Swapcard is the leading AI-powered event platform designed to drive revenue growth and foster meaningful connections at in-person and hybrid events. Our Vision

At Swapcard, we believe in the power of meaningful connections. This belief fuels our commitment to pioneering modern solutions that empower organizers to create engaging event experiences.

Guided by our commitment to excellence and collaboration, we aim to redefine the landscape of event technology, setting new standards for engagement, accessibility, and impact.

Our Beliefs

At Swapcard, diversity is at the core of our success. With 42 nationalities represented among our 180+ team members, we champion diversity as a catalyst for creativity, collaboration, and unparalleled innovation.

We believe that by embracing a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and viewpoints, we can truly understand and cater to the needs of our global community of event organizers and participants.

Our full remote opportunities empower our team to thrive, no matter where they are in the world, fostering a culture of flexibility and inclusion.

What you will be doing?

  • Build efficient and robust data pipelines for large volumes of data, from internal databases and SaaS applications, using Fivetran, Airbyte or Python.
  • Develop and optimize transformation data models using Redshift, Dbt, Dagster and other tools.
  • Monitor and maintain our cloud data warehouse (Redshift) with timely and quality data.
  • Set and ensure data engineering standards as part of the department goals.
  • Collaborate with other teams to ensure data engineering needs/requests are addressed.
  • Create and maintain documentations.

What you should have?

  • 5+ years hands-on experience deploying code in production.
  • At least 2 years of exp with DBT with hands-on experience delivering transformation pipelines with Dbt.
  • Demonstrably deep understanding of SQL and data warehouse.
  • Hands-on experience implementing ETL.
  • Experience working with Python.
  • Experience working with a workflow orchestrator (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Kestra, …)
  • At least 4 years of exp with a cloud data warehouse
  • Fluency in English.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with AWS (e.g: Redshift).
  • Experience with Dagster.
  • Experience with data vizualisation tools (e.g Tableau).
  • Knowledge in Infra toolchain (e.g Docker, Terraform, Helm).

  2. A remote exercise to demonstrate and assess your skills.
  3. Manager review with your future reporting manager

  5. Reference check conducted by our people team
  6. Offer

Swapcard's Values

Curious : We ask questions, try new things and take risks. We learn from one another and see mistakes as opportunities to grow—what matters most is how we react and learn from them. We are curious about what something is and why something is. Innovation thrives when curiosity drives.

Value-Driven: At Swapcard, we focus on making each decision count by prioritising outcomes that create meaningful value for our customers, team members, and partners.

Human : At Swapcard, being human means fostering empathy, openness, and diversity to create a caring and collaborative community. We’re driven by a strong team spirit and a shared goal of building meaningful connections—both through our product and within our team.

Resilient : We embrace challenges with optimism, creativity, and adaptability, constantly seeking innovative solutions and opportunities for growth.

Ownership: At Swapcard, we take responsibility and are accountable for our actions, driving success through initiative, trust, and accountability. True ownership means more than just completing tasks; it's about being proactive, investing ourselves fully in the outcomes, and fostering a culture of trust.

  • Open-minded culture that appreciates differences

Equal Opportunity

Atuamos de forma estratégica e integrada, apoiando as metas comerciais, promovendo a imagem da marca e criando campanhas que geram valor para o negócio. Com foco em inovação, performance e relacionamento, nosso papel é posicionar a Vitta como referência no mercado e contribuir para um crescimento sustentável.

Como é ser um(a) Analista de Marketing:

No seu dia a dia, você vai:

  • Produção de Materiais de Comunicação: Criação e revisão de conteúdos institucionais e materiais de apoio para clientes, como apresentações, e-books, guias e comunicações de produto;

  • Acompanhamento de Resultados: Monitoramento de indicadores das ações de marketing e sugestão de melhorias com base em dados.

title: LCA Lead | Life Cycle Analysis Lead
description:
About InPlanet

We are an impact-driven, remote-first, ClimateTech (CDR) startup headquartered in Germany and Brazil to reverse climate change and make tropical agriculture more regenerative, low-carbon, and sustainable. We are working with Enhanced Rock Weathering in tropical agriculture, focusing on Brazil. We do this to create a liveable planet for future generations and, specifically, to regenerate soils and ecosystems, grow nutritious food, and increase food security and sovereignty in the tropics.
People-first, Performance Culture: We believe that focus on people and performance can co-exist with the right cultural vision. Our philosophy is to blend these two essential components. The Rocket symbolizes our commitment to peak performance, excellence, and reaching new heights. The Heart represents our dedication to our people, fostering empathy, compassion, and genuine care for every team member's well-being.
We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are proud to have an internationally growing team and we are designing our people practices to serve psychological safety, belonging, and authenticity.

Key Responsibilities

LCA Development & Execution

  • Conduct full Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) for mining, rock sourcing, transportation, and field spreading processes .
  • Ensure compliance with ISO standards , GHG Protocols, IPCC guidelines, and relevant carbon accounting frameworks .
  • Quantify the carbon footprint and co-benefits of InPlanet’s Enhanced Rock Weathering projects for emissions avoidance and reductions linked to changes in agronomic practices.

Scalability & Process Optimization

  • Develop scalable LCA methodologies to streamline assessment processes across multiple projects.
  • Integrate automation tools where possible to reduce manual data collection bottlenecks .
  • Identify opportunities for emissions reduction in our supply chain and propose actionable sustainability strategies.

Carbon Reporting & Certification

  • Produce Greenhouse Gas (GHG) statements and carbon accounting reports to support MRV (Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification) requirements .
  • Work closely with internal and external stakeholders to align LCA outputs with carbon credit certification needs .

Stakeholder & Data Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with mines and supply chain partners to facilitate accurate and timely data collection.
  • Coordinate with farmers and supply chain teams to ensure high-quality input data .
  • Troubleshoot data gaps when mines or other partners do not provide necessary information (e.g. secondary mine process data).

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Work cross-functionally to ensure that LCA insights inform strategic decision-making at InPlanet.
  • Present findings to internal teams and external partners, communicating complex sustainability assessments in a clear and actionable manner .

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes.
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency.
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience with LCA methodologies and tools (e.g., SimaPro, OpenLCA, GaBi , or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with ISO 14040/14044 LCA standards and/or GHG accounting protocols .
  • 7+ years of experience in carbon accounting and sustainability impact assessments .
  • Knowledge of mining, agriculture, or supply chain sustainability is a strong plus.
  • Ability to structure LCAs for scalability in a fast-growing company.
Key Qualities
  • High attention to detail —accuracy in sustainability reporting is critical.
  • Solution-oriented mindset —doesn’t just point out gaps, but proposes fixes and optimisations.
  • Ability to build strong relationships with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Driven and resilient —pushes forward despite data collection challenges.
  • Comfortable with uncertainty —navigates the evolving landscape of carbon markets with adaptability.
Bonus Points (but not essential)
  • Certified LCA Practitioner (ACLCA)
  • Greenhouse Gas Accounting Certification (GHG Protocol, ISO 14064)
  • Certified Carbon Auditor
  • ISO 14040/14044 LCA Training

Benefits

  • Salary expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly. Competitive.
  • Share options (ESOP) to make you feel like an owner.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: Join us from anywhere within the CET (- 4/5-hour time zones).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 34+ days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference, and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

About the Role

Location: Brazil (Preferably near São Paulo)
Languages: Fluent in Portuguese & English

At InPlanet, we are pioneering the use of Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) as a scalable carbon removal solution. To ensure the credibility and scientific rigor of our impact, Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) plays a critical role in evaluating the full environmental footprint of our operations—from rock sourcing to CO₂ sequestration.
As our LCA Lead, you will spearhead the development and execution of LCAs for our ongoing and future projects. You will work closely with cross-functional teams—including Science, Operations, Carbon Accounting, and Business Development—to navigate complex sustainability frameworks, structure LCA methodologies for scalability, and produce reliable greenhouse gas (GHG) assessments that feed into our carbon credit issuance process.
This is a high-impact role at the core of our mission. If you're passionate about climate solutions and have a track record of data-driven sustainability analysis, we’d love to have you on board.

The Impact You Can Make

  • Develop and execute high-quality LCAs to quantify the environmental footprint of our supply chain, from rock mining to field application.
  • Establish scalable methodologies and refine LCA frameworks that can be applied efficiently across multiple geographies and project types.
  • Enable InPlanet to meet the strictest carbon market standards , ensuring credibility in the issuance of high-quality carbon removal credits.
  • Strengthen our network by building trust with mining and farming stakeholders , optimising data collection, and improving transparency.
  • Support the integration of LCA insights into business decisions , helping to shape strategic choices around material sourcing, transportation, and field deployment.

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate.
The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach.
These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Application Process

Roughly 8 hours across 3-7 weeks from CV screening.

  • Interview with Talent & People Partner or Head of People (values & motivation)
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • (optional third interview)
  • Challenge with 3+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Potential in-person follow-up interview.
  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling
  • Offer

How to Apply

  • We kindly ask you to submit your CV in English, as this is the main language we use here at InPlanet (unless it is justified to be in Portuguese).

Being an equal opportunities employer is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning.

Também é legal você saber que...
Um dos nossos 7 valores é o “Sawabona", seu significado é pra lá de especial, e praticado diariamente aqui na Zappts!
A saudação #Sawabona se originou no Sul da África, onde se acredita que todos nascemos pessoas boas, mas que, às vezes, podemos cometer alguns erros.
Segundo a cultura deste lugar, quando alguém comete erros, toda a população se junta e, durante dois dias, só falam sobre as coisas boas que aquela pessoa já fez. Ao final desse período, todo o povo cumprimenta seu conterrâneo com a expressão "Sawabona".
Esse, por sua vez, responde "#Shikoba" . Sendo assim, Sawabona significa: "Eu te vejo, eu te respeito, você é importante para mim" . E a resposta, Shikoba: "Então eu sou bom e existo para você" .
Aqui na Zappts, Sawabona traduz e representa o que mais prezamos em nossas relações: o respeito e a valorização do outro.
Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia e sentiu conexão com os nossos valores, venha para nossa tribo aqui é seu lugar!
