Overview

Join to apply for the IoT Solutions Architecture Manager role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an IoT Solutions Architecture Manager to lead a regionally-focused team of Field engineers in Presales and Professional Services activities, by helping customers with solution architecture, design and delivery.

Location: This is a remote role, running a team in one of three Geos, Americas, EMEA or APAC. You will therefore need to be located in one of those three Geos to manage that specific team that spans a few timezones from you.

Our Internet of Things mission is to enable companies to make fleets of very secure connected devices. Canonical provides the base Ubuntu OS and kernel, with secure update and management mechanisms. Our customers create mission-critical control systems, gateways and appliances that need to meet stringent quality and security requirements, and we aspire to bring this level of security to the wider consumer electronics and device market.

Our Field Engineers are thought leaders helping our customers solve hard problems. They are accomplished technologists that take a hands-on approach to embedded Linux strategy and delivery. They have a passion to help customers achieve ambitious technical and business goals, and to show how the Canonical approach to open source and connected devices brings best-of-breed thinking to the emerging field of edge compute. They also care to develop their colleagues, helping them deepen their understanding of the technology, their ability to manage time, and their awareness of customer business thinking for continuous improvement and personal development.

This career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well and be proficient coders and scripters. They will have experience of low-level Linux boot, BIOS, firmware and embedded software development methodologies. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business-focused technologists at heart, they are also team drivers that take pride in team and company wins.

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  • Extensive embedded Linux experience - Yocto or other
  • Extensive Linux experience - Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, Python, C, C++, or Rust
  • Ability to manage a small team
  • Experience with customer engagements
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • An ability to communicate the business benefits of technology
  • An humble learner and quick study

Other desirable traits include RTOS experience, additional languages (both the programming and human kinds), and previous experience working in a remote-first, diverse, distributed company.

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Data Service Module Engineer to develop and deploy the data service module for the HPC modeling project. This role focuses on implementing high-performance data storage and retrieval systems using HDF5 or similar, with parallel and concurrent I/O capabilities. The ideal candidate will have expertise in designing scalable data services optimized for HPC or distributed workflows, ensuring low latency and high throughput.

Key Responsibilities

  • Module Development and Deployment: Design and implement the data service module using HDF5 for efficient data storage and retrieval.
  • Develop parallel and concurrent I/O mechanisms to optimize performance for large-scale datasets.
  • Ensure the module is tightly integrated with HPC and visualization workflows.

Performance Optimization

  • Optimize I/O operations for CPU/GPU-based workflows to minimize bottlenecks.
  • Implement caching, compression, and other strategies to enhance performance.

Data Management

  • Design data structures and schemas suitable for storing 3D grid data and other simulation outputs.
  • Ensure data integrity and consistency during concurrent read/write operations.

Testing and Validation

  • Develop and execute test cases to validate module performance and reliability under various load conditions.
  • Conduct benchmarking to ensure scalability across different hardware configurations.

Documentation and Support

  • Document the architecture, APIs, and usage guidelines for the data service module.
  • Provide technical support to the development and visualization teams for data integration.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in developing and deploying data services for HPC or similar systems.
  • Proven expertise with HDF5 or similar, in parallel I/O operations. Equivalent experience in distributed systems is also applicable.

Technical Skills

  • Programming: Strong proficiency in (at least one): C++, Python, GoLang, or Fortran.
  • HDF5 Expertise: In-depth knowledge of HDF5 APIs and advanced features like parallel HDF5.
  • Parallel I/O: Experience with MPI I/O, POSIX I/O, or similar frameworks for concurrent/parallel data access.
  • Performance Optimization: Skills in profiling and optimizing I/O operations for large datasets.
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with any RDMS
  • Knowledge of at least one orchestration and scheduling tool (e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster) is a plus.

Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a multidisciplinary team.
  • Excellent communication skills for cross-team collaboration and documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with data formats used in scientific computing, 3D visualization, and simulation workflows.

title: Junior Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Junior Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Every year we select new junior professionals into the Canonical Kernel Team, to work on the Linux kernel for Ubuntu. If you've enjoyed operating systems in your coursework or current role, you are confident in your ability to write high quality C and possibly Rust, and are ready to take the plunge and see how it all works, then this would be a great place to pursue your next career stage. We are a global team working to ship the world's most widely used Linux kernel, across the very latest silicon and cloud, where you can apply and grow your software engineering skills.

The Canonical Kernel Team builds and maintains all supported Ubuntu Linux kernels for a variety of platforms and architectures from small embedded devices to standard desktop/server systems to large-scale cloud environments. In your first year you will tackle serious initiatives, which include but are not limited to:

  • Optimized solutions for key Silicon and Cloud partner platforms
  • Developer platforms such as Raspberry Pi and RISC-V
  • Enabling Ubuntu on a wide range of embedded systems
  • Security hardening and exploit mitigation
  • Third-party driver integration and distribution, such as graphics
  • Expanded driver support for bleeding-edge PC platforms

We select candidates that are recent university graduates or early career professionals who are enthusiastic to develop kernel-level software in multiple areas including security updates, patching, and testing. The successful candidate will have a background in software engineering, be motivated to work in a distributed team and willing and able to travel globally twice a year for company engineering events.

These are full-time positions available to prospective or recently graduated students.

title: Client Operations Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Client Operations Manager role at Chore

As the Operations Program Manager / Chief of Staff (Client Accounts), you’ll run back-office ops (HR, Finance, Compliance) for multiple startups—owning delivery, triaging edge cases, and building scalable processes.

About Us

Chore exists to make every startup and SMB in the world successful. We believe that the more successful startups, the better a world we’ll all experience.

Operations are foundational yet most companies chronically underinvest in them to their detriment. We build and maintain their back-office operations so that they can focus on their differentiating superpowers.

We work behind the scenes to help our clients win. We like efficiency. We geek out on checklists. We are transparent with each other and our clients. We are professional, inclusive, and autonomous and our goal is to provide a culture that fosters long-term success, is reputation & trust-based, fun, and pushes each of us to always learn.

We are looking for proactive, detail-oriented individuals interested in joining as a "Chore CEO" (what we call our operation program managers). Lead multi-workstream back-office programs (HR/Finance/Compliance) for startups; unblock teams and leaders, and deliver outcomes across a client portfolio.

You are the main conduit through which all our client's back-office operations run. You are their project manager and leader. You are the person they trust to keep things running so they can focus on their product and sales.

A Chore CEO serves as a fractional Chief of Staff/Chief Operating Officer — working with multiple startup founders / CEOs to project manage key corporate matters. These responsibilities are often tactical, but as you build trusted relationships with the CEOs of these world-changing startups, you will also become their strategic partner. In short, you are the unsung hero and critical foundation to their startup. Successful project manager operations leads get it done, figure it out, proactively get ahead of problems, and communicate every step.

Some examples of the work we do

  • The operations team is sometimes the dumping ground for things that don't go anywhere else. While others are bothered by that, we revel in it. We get it done when no one else can.
  • Use judgment and thoughtfulness — “can you work with our accountant to get taxes filed?” or “can you get this NDA out to a customer and coordinate if there are any issues?”
  • Research and problem-solving for back-office edge cases.
  • Be smart enough and skilled enough to jump from a finance question to an HR question to a vendor question.
  • We handle the complex unknowns.
  • Strategic work — e.g., “how should I think about compensation and benchmarks for my company?” We’ve seen this organically happen at times when OPs have built a trusted relationship with clients.

Qualifications/Skills

  • 5+ years of startup business experience that includes interfacing with clients or external parties is required.
  • 2+ years experience in at least two of the following: Project management, Product management, Customer Success, Client Operations, HR, Finance, Legal/Law/Attorney, or Compliance.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and excellent ability to context switch.
  • Great communication skills: this includes not only an ability to talk on a call but much more so, write down every step and communicate the value of that step, effectively.
  • Ability to say "no" in a way that doesn’t feel like a "no" to the other party.
  • You love building deep, trusting relationships with dynamic founders across many industries.
  • Are a total geek for better processes, more standardization, and reinventing things just enough to make them more efficient. You enjoy improving every day. You know what Kaizen means and the fact we care about it excites you.
  • Checking items off of your work list, while also considering ‘how can I do this process more efficiently,’ brings a smile to your face. There is always more to do for clients and you thrive on getting things done while simultaneously knowing that you are helping to move these amazing startups forward.
  • People who have a deep dedication to client service and doing right by our stakeholders.
  • Seeing delight on a client's face brings delight to your day.
  • Ability to focus in stressful situations and almost automatically prioritize.
  • Openness to giving and receiving feedback.
  • You don't mind doing the unsexy part of running a startup - i.e. dealing with regulators (including waiting on hold forever for them to pick up), managing employee offboarding, and basically doing the "startup plumber" work.
  • If you believe you deserve to only work on "sexy things" then this isn’t the role for you. We live in the unsexy but critical.
  • You want to join a passionate, fun and kind team for the long-term (2+ years). While this role might be a stepping stone and we celebrate our team member’s growth, if you apply, our assumption is that you’d prefer a job where you can see yourself for several years.

Compensation

  • Base compensation, starting compensation is $40,000 USD per year but we expect most teammates, once ramped and with bonus, will earn around $52,000 USD or more per year.
  • Every team member receives equity in Chore, which is variable based on level. Since we're building for the long-term, we offer equity on the high side.
  • Note: we do not negotiate as we believe it is biased against various groups and creates poor dynamics. Instead, we pay and promote based on performance and meeting clearly defined metrics.

The Best Parts

  • ️ We are fully remote, do not require any travel and have somewhat flexible hours! The expectation is that all Chore CEOs work standard US hours from 9-5pm.
  • We’re good people who work well together while solving critical problems for awesome startups.
  • WFH stipend up to $250/month (office setup, coffees, co-working space, etc).
  • Why is "executive" coaching only valuable for executives? We think that's stupid. Optional coaching 2x/mo.
  • Only four ~30-minute team meetings/week.
  • Support from a team of other experts and teamwork to complete your work.

Additional Notes

  • There will be five 15-60 minute interviews via Google Meet, one of which is a Q&A with another Chore CEO to vet the role for you, too!
  • To help set you up for the success, half of the questions are provided for the 1st interview
  • We will ask for up to 4 former (or current) manager references.

If you want us to consider your application, you must apply to the role via the form.

We like fun and making some magic. Join us. You'll learn more and, we expect, have more fun than any other role you've ever had.

You will be managing the projects that involve the delivery of Ubuntu images on a wide variety of devices ranging from robots, edge gateways, and IoT devices to PCs and automotive systems.   • PMP/PMI or PRINCE2 Practitioner Certification preferred

Textron Aviation has been inspiring the journey of flight for nine decades through the iconic and beloved Cessna and Beechcraft brands. We are passionate advocates of aviation, empowering people with the freedom of flight. As you join our legacy as a global leader in private aviation, you’ll have opportunities to try new fields, expand your skills and knowledge, stretch your abilities, and build your career. We provide a competitive and extensive total rewards package that includes pay and innovative benefits to support you and your family members – now and in the future, beginning day one. Your success is our success.

Description

JOB SUMMARY:

The Service Sales Manager- Programs will be responsible for selling ProAdvantage products to current and prospective owners and operators of Textron Aviation aircraft. ProAdvantage is Textron Aviation’s cost per flight hour maintenance program for Citation, Hawker, King Air and Caravans. This role is responsible for managing new enrollments, upselling, and contract transfers.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Focus on selling ProAdvantage products to customers that own or who are purchasing Textron Aviation products including Cessna Citation, Caravan, King Air and Hawker aircraft.
  • Responsible for tracking aircraft transactions within territory and marketing ProAdvantage as early in the process as possible.
  • Research and identify potential sales opportunities using available reports and tools. Actively seek and identify cross-sell and up-sell service opportunities. Aggressively pursue sales leads provided by Textron Aviation employees and satisfied customers.
  • Use a variety of marketing techniques to generate and secure ProAdvantage sales: hosting Service Center visits, telemarketing, organizing/participating customer engagement events, and written correspondence to name a few. Utilize and maintain a customer data base.
  • Build proposals, calculate enrollment fees, draft contracts, request open account and coordinate all documents necessary to enroll new customers on ProAdvantage.
  • Identify opportunities to upsell new programs to existing customers. (i.e. Propose Protech/Labor program to a customer enrolling or renewing ProParts).
  • Receive and process customers’ requests for Program termination due to aircraft sale and ensure the new buyer continues with ProAdvantage enrollment for their aircraft.
  • Transfer ProAdvantage contracts to the new buyer of an aircraft while attempting to upsell additional products. (i.e. Proposing Protech/Labor program to a customer transferring ProParts).
  • Specifically track used aircraft sales/deliveries, identify aircraft enrolled with ProAdvantage, and ensure proper documentation is in place with the new buyer, also prospecting potential ProAdvantage opportunities for non-enrolled aircraft.
  • Responsible for Contract Assignments and engine upgrades / conversions
Qualifications

EDUCATION/ EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Aviation Management, or related discipline
  • Minimum 3 years sales and/or marketing experience required

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • SalesForce.com and the Microsoft suite.
  • Professional appearance and demeanor
  • Candidate must be able to work in an autonomous self-directed environment to achieve the marketing strategies and sales goals set forth by the company.
  • Candidate must possess strong communication skills (written and oral) to achieve relationships with local aircraft owners, operators, directors of maintenance, and brokers.
  • Candidate must be willing to travel at least 50% of the time in all associated markets.
  • A&P or Pilot license preferred.

About Us
We’re an international remote-first staffing company scaling fast—and behind our growth is a strong IT foundation. We’re looking for a hands-on IT Admin Specialist who can manage internal systems, secure access, and support technical operations across teams using Google Workspace, HR platforms, CRMs, and cloud-based tools.
Role Overview
This is a mid-level IT role focused on systems admin, user access, security protocols, and general tech support. You’ll manage admin panels, domain settings, employee provisioning, and ensure tools are secure, compliant, and functioning seamlessly. Your work enables every team to operate productively and securely.
Key Responsibilities

  • Set up and offboard users across systems including Google Workspace, HR tools (e.g. Deel), CRMs (e.g. HubSpot), and Slack.
  • Maintain system-level controls including 2FA, VPN setup, password policies, and MDM practices.

  • Oversee domain and DNS management, ensuring proper routing, SPF/DKIM records, and uptime.
  • Perform regular audits of user permissions, system logs, and compliance checklists.
  • Document IT processes and help desk protocols to ensure support continuity and transparency.
  • Assist in light database admin tasks, including cleaning, backing up, and updating internal data systems.
  • Recommend improvements to internal IT systems and automation strategies.
Qualifications
  • 3+ years in an IT administrator, systems support, or remote tech ops role.
  • Strong proficiency in Google Workspace Admin Panel and related productivity tools.
  • Comfortable managing user roles and integrations in SaaS platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Deel, ClickUp).
  • Solid understanding of VPNs, 2FA, MDM, and access control protocols.
  • Mid-level comfort with database structure and handling (e.g., CSV imports, relational data understanding).
  • Basic scripting, DNS/domain troubleshooting, or admin-level email configuration is a strong plus.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable working independently in a remote-first environment

title: Especialista em Implementação e Suporte de ON!Track
description:
O que procuramos?

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa com perfil comercial, excelente capacidade de comunicação e apresentação, que tenha facilidade para redesenhar processos operacionais dos clientes, identificar gaps e implementar melhorias usando as soluções digitais da Hilti, especialmente o ON!Track (solução digital que ajuda empresas a gerenciar ferramentas, equipamentos e ativos em tempo real). Este papel é essencial para garantir uma experiência de cliente excepcional e sustentável, atuando em parceria com os times de vendas e marketing locais e regionais.

Em que se consiste o trabalho?

Você será responsável por liderar a implementação dos nossos serviços digitais, com foco em:
  • Treinamento de clientes e melhoria de processos operacionais.
  • Compreensão profunda dos fluxos de trabalho dos clientes para aumentar a produtividade com as soluções Hilti.
  • Coordenação com os times de vendas e marketing locais e regionais para garantir colaboração e inovação.
  • Apoio ao lançamento e adoção de novas funcionalidades dos serviços.
  • Atuação prática e estratégica junto aos clientes, com visitas frequentes e engajamento direto.
  • Este papel exige mobilidade frequente em todo o Brasil,de 2 a 3 semanas por mês (de segunda a sexta-feira).

Isto é o que você precisará:

  • Formação superior completa (não é necessário curso específico).
  • Experiência comercial com foco em relacionamento com clientes.
  • Habilidades de comunicação, apresentação e engajamento.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e pensar de forma operacional.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.
  • Inglês intermediário (desejável).

Por que vale a pena enviar sua candidatura?

Nossos funcionários compartilham um estilo muito próprio de ser. São determinados e dedicados, dando sempre o melhor si para exceder as expectativas dos nossos clientes. Em contrapartida, usufruem de carreiras incrivelmente dinâmicas e diversificadas. 93% dos nossos colaboradores dizem estar orgulhosos em trabalhar para a Hilti, graças à qualidade dos nossos produtos e a forma como cuidamos dos nossos colaboradores.

O que oferecemos?

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico
  • Vale alimentação/refeição
  • PPR – Plano de Participação nos Resultados
  • Totalpass (convênio com academias)
  • Seguro de Vida
  • EAP - Programa de Orientação Pessoal (Psicológica, Jurídica, Financeira e Social)
  • Niverday – 1 dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário
  • Auxílio Educacional
  • Premiação por tempo de serviço
  • Cultura de cuidado: gifts em datas especiais
  • Convênio com SESC/SENAC
  • Modelo de trabalho flexível
  • Descontos em produtos

description:
Location: Remote
Need: Experience with Klaviyo

Description:

We’re looking for a sharp, creative, and data-driven Email Marketing Strategist who knows Klaviyo inside out and can turn email and SMS channels into revenue machines. This is for a fast-growing marketing agency that partners with DTC brands to deliver real results—not vanity metrics.

If you love building campaigns and flows that actually convert, get a kick out of testing subject lines and segmentation, and can read performance data like it’s a novel, this role is for you. You’ll own email and SMS strategy for a portfolio of DTC brands, working closely with clients, creatives, and performance teams to make every send count.

What You’ll Do:

→ Own the Strategy: Develop and execute email & SMS marketing plans that drive retention, engagement, and sales.
→ Build Flows that Work: Design and optimize automated flows (welcome, abandon cart, post-purchase, etc.) that deliver measurable results.
→ Segment Like a Pro: Create audience segments based on behavior, demographics, and purchase history for hyper-targeted campaigns.
→ Analyze & Optimize: Track KPIs (open rate, CTR, conversions, deliverability) and make data-backed adjustments to improve performance.
→ Creative Collaboration: Work with designers and copywriters to ensure emails not only look amazing but convert.
→ Stay Ahead of Trends: Keep up with best practices in Klaviyo, email deliverability, and retention marketing.


What We’re Looking For:

→ Experience Required: 1–3 years in email marketing with proven Klaviyo experience (agency or DTC brand experience preferred).
→ Retention-Obsessed: You understand the lifecycle of a customer and how to keep them coming back.
→ Data-Driven Mindset: You can interpret metrics and turn them into actionable strategy.
→ Strong Communication Skills: You can explain your ideas clearly to both creative teams and clients.
→ Attention to Detail: From subject lines to send times, you sweat the small stuff.
→ Bonus Points: Experience with SMS marketing and A/B testing tools.


Why This Role Rocks:

→ Creative Freedom: Bring your ideas to life without getting buried in corporate red tape.
→ Cool Clients: Work with exciting DTC brands doing innovative things—not boring legacy accounts.
→ Remote & Flexible: Work from wherever you want—results matter more than hours.
→ Fast-Growing Agency: Be part of a team that’s scaling quickly, opening up real career growth opportunities.
→ Collaborative Culture: Work with people who actually care about doing great work and having fun along the way.

How to Apply:

If Klaviyo is your playground and you’re ready to craft email strategies that move the needle, apply now!

title: UX/UI Engineer
description:
Overview

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products across health, education, and entertainment. One of RubyLabs’ portfolio companies is looking for a mid-level UI/UX Engineer to join our team and take full ownership of designing and implementing user interfaces using pre-built component libraries. This role is perfect for a frontend engineer who enjoys working within structured design systems and ensuring high-quality, data-driven user experiences. You will be responsible for both defining the UI structure using existing components and implementing it in code—without relying on a separate designer. If you thrive in a results-driven environment, value autonomy, and enjoy building intuitive, scalable UI without subjective design guesswork, this is the role for you.

Responsibilities

  • UI/UX design and implementation: Design web interfaces using pre-built components (NextUI, HeroUI, Tailwind).
  • Ensure consistency, usability, and accessibility across designs.
  • Create wireframes and layouts based on structured design principles.
  • Frontend development: Implement designs using NextUI, HeroUI, and Tailwind CSS on top of Next.js and React.
  • Develop and maintain scalable, maintainable, and performant UI and reusable components.
  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and responsiveness.
  • Collaboration and process: Work with product managers to translate data-driven requirements into UI solutions.
  • Ensure seamless handoff between design and development by owning both parts of the process.
  • Maintain high coding standards and efficient workflows.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of frontend development experience (Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind).
  • Strong understanding of UI/UX principles and ability to work within structured design systems.
  • Experience with UI component libraries (NextUI, HeroUI, or similar).

At Trustly, we’re on a mission to deliver a better way to pay and get paid. Consumers deserve a payment option that prioritizes financial responsibility, and merchants should have the independence to accept payments without unnecessary costs. This mission drives everything we do.

We’re revolutionizing the payments industry by making Pay by Bank the new standard at checkout, providing a smarter payment option to credit and debit cards. For merchants and consumers, this means the freedom to make and receive payments with greater security and ease.

Fueled by this purpose, we’ve grown into a global network connecting 9,000 merchants to 650 million consumers through 12,000 banks across 33 countries, processing over $58 billion annually. As the leader in Pay by Bank, we aim to redefine the payments experience by delivering exceptional products and unmatched value.

With regional offices in Vitória, Brazil and Silicon Valley, USA, and our global headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, we are a diverse team that spans over 30 nationalities. Embracing a culture of innovation and collaboration, our 'work from anywhere' policy allows employees in Brazil, the U.S., and Canada to work remotely within their country of residence, enabling flexibility while staying connected to our global team.

At Trustly, we believe that inclusion and diversity are essential foundations for building a fair and equitable society. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, ancestry, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, or disability status. Our main goal is to provide a fair, welcoming, diverse environment with opportunities for all collaborators. The stages of our selection process take place online and without distinction of any kind.

Now is the perfect time to join us and help accomplish our mission. If you’re inspired by purpose, thrive in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment, and are ready to shape the future of payments, we’d love to hear from you!

About the team

The Underwriting team is responsible for reviewing all new and existing insourced deals holistically by analyzing the merchants' compliance framework and risk controls, financial conditions, historical performance, and regulatory and legal environment.


What you will do:
  • Evaluate merchant applications and supporting documentation to assess Merchant’s credit and reputational risk.
  • Review financial statements and/or business tax returns and performs analysis to recommend merchant’s risk ratings.
  • Analyze complex corporate structures, beneficial ownership and licensing requirements, coordinating with the Compliance and Legal teams as needed.
  • Review industry information and comparisons, key risks and mitigants to form a general risk overview of merchants.
  • Summarize analysis in concise credit memo and complete all required underwriting checklists.
  • Underwrite according to applicable regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
  • Conduct periodic reviews for existing merchants to facilitate ongoing risk monitoring and management.
  • Maintain productivity standard goals as established by management.
  • Assist the Commercial team with customer calls for larger merchants requiring explanation of specific credit risks, internal credit policies and/or underwriting decisions.
  • Other duties as assigned.
Who you are:
  • High level of English proficiency both in oral and written communication.
  • Experience in a commercial underwriting role at a fintech, financial institution or payment service provider; experience underwriting complex multinational corporations is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or related discipline required.
  • Ability to analyze financial, bank, and processing statements to assess credit worthiness of merchants.
  • Review complex corporate structures, licenses, and beneficial ownership, coordinating with the compliance and legal teams as needed.
  • Familiarity with Know your Customer (KYC), Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and payment processing requirements in North America.
  • Ability to solve practical problems and interpret a variety of data furnished in oral, written, or schedule form.
  • Must be detail oriented, and able to manage and prioritize multiple tasks.
  • Prior payment and Fintech experience is a plus.
Our perks and benefits:

Responsibilities:

Client Execution & Project Management

  • Support A/B testing strategy creation, execution, and reporting
  • Apply best practices in messaging hierarchy, user experience, and mobile-first design
  • Maintain knowledge of platform and ad network guidelines (Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, etc.)

Content & QA Support

  • Draft or refine landing page copy tailored to target personas, offers, and funnel stage
  • Review landing pages for accuracy, responsiveness, and proper integration with forms, calendars, pixels, and CRMs
  • Work with developers and creative teams to ensure pages meet quality standards prior to launch
  • Work alongside the Managing Director to operationalize best practices and document repeatable workflows
  • Help maintain and improve internal tools such as audit templates, performance trackers, and testing roadmaps
  • Contribute to ongoing training and resource development for internal teams and freelancers
  • Proactively identify areas for improvement across design, process, messaging, or reporting

Role Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO or running Landing Page projects (agency experience preferred)..
  • Portfolio of work examples with proven results
  • Experience working with Landing Page & CRM platforms: Unbounce, Hubspot, Marketo, etc
  • Experience working with design platforms like Figma
  • Experience with user behavior tools like Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, etc

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Implement AI-driven automation 50%+ of landing page workflows.
  • On-time delivery of landing page milestones (strategy, copy, QA, launch)
  • Conversion rate performance vs. benchmark or prior page
  • Number of launched landing pages per month
  • Client satisfaction and internal team feedback
  • A/B testing velocity and learnings logged

Most Important Things (MITs)

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)

Transformar a vida das pessoas através de inovação e tecnologia , este é o nosso propósito. Estamos procurando um(a) Pessoa Engenheira de Dados que queira impulsionar a inovação conosco!
Somos um Instituto de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento formado por um time de pessoas incríveis, com ideias inovadoras, possuímos um ambiente descontraído e muito espírito colaborativo.
Promovemos em nosso dia-a-dia um ambiente de desenvolvimento , onde os Atlantes são o nosso maior foco, por isso um dos nossos valores mais fortes é a “Valorização de Pessoas” . Não é à toa, que estamos entre as melhores empresas de TI para se trabalhar no Brasil, segundo o ranking do GPTW.
Formação Acadêmica:

  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Ciência de Dados ou área relacionada.
  • Pós-graduação, Mestrado ou Doutorado é desejável.
Responsabilidades:
  • Colaborar com clientes para entender suas necessidades de dados e desenvolver soluções eficientes para extrair, transformar, armazenar e exibir dados.
  • Pesquisar sistemas internos para identificar dados disponíveis, sua estrutura, métodos de acesso e otimizar seu uso em sistemas e aplicações novos ou existentes.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de sistemas complementares que melhorem a disponibilidade de dados para a equipe do cliente.
  • Gerenciar múltiplas solicitações de alta prioridade simultaneamente, adaptando-se às mudanças de prioridades.
  • Identificar e interagir com as equipes do cliente para aprofundar o conhecimento das fontes de dados e tecnologias.
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e aprimoramento de pipelines de dados, gerenciando novas solicitações de recursos e comunicando-se regularmente com os gerentes do clientes.
  • Desenvolver e manter plataformas para compartilhamento de dados e dashboards.
  • Criar documentação abrangente sobre fontes de dados, métodos de acesso, contatos-chave e outras informações relevantes.
  • Apresentar resultados obtidos para stakeholders em todos os níveis (técnicos e não técnicos) de forma clara e concisa.
Requisitos obrigatórios:
  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de processamento de dados em larga escala e à nível de produção, utilizando tecnologias distribuídas.
  • Experiência na configuração e utilização de plataformas de dados, especificamente soluções de dados baseadas em nuvem, incluindo a capacidade de provisionar e configurar recursos.
  • Experiência com Python (preferencialmente) ou outras linguagens para ciência de dados e análise.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e SQL.
  • Experiência com bibliotecas populares de análise de dados (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-learn, etc.).
  • Experiência com bibliotecas populares de visualização de dados (Tableau Desktop/Server, matplotlib, seaborn, plotly, etc.).
  • Experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de dados.
  • Experiência no design, construção e otimização de pipelines e plataformas de dados em larga escala utilizando:
  • Frameworks de processamento de dados distribuídos, por exemplo: Apache Spark, Apache Flink ou tecnologias similares baseadas em MapReduce
  • Sistemas de gerenciamento de recursos e armazenamento de Big Data, por exemplo: HDFS, YARN ou equivalentes em nuvem como S3, EMR
  • Ferramentas de orquestração de fluxo de trabalho, por exemplo: Apache Airflow, Dagster, Prefect
  • Formatos de tabela de data lake modernos, por exemplo: Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Apache Hudi
  • Mecanismos de consulta SQL distribuídos para data lakes, por exemplo: Trino/Presto
  • Experiência na criação de soluções para adquirir e persistir novas fontes de dados para uso por cientistas de dados e analistas.
  • Experiência no uso de serviços baseados em nuvem, como AWS ou GCP, para transferência, processamento e armazenamento de dados.
Idioma:
  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita, conversação, técnico) para contato diário com parceiros no exterior.
Desejável:
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de rede, autenticação, criptografia e outras tecnologias que permitem uma comunicação de rede segura e eficiente.
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias de processamento em tempo real, como Kafka, Kinesis ou equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento de competências essenciais de gerenciamento de dados, incluindo governança, segurança e qualidade de dados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de integração de dados (Pentaho, OWB/ODI, SSIS, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de exploração de dados (Jupyter Notebook, iPython, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de padrões de design comuns no desenvolvimento de software (MVC, MVVM, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias como Hadoop, Hive, Cassandra e Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento prático de sistemas de controle de versão de software (Git preferencialmente).
Vem ser Atlante!!!
DIVERSIDADE E INCLUSÃO:
No Atlântico, a diversidade e a inclusão são compromissos inegociáveis. Como instituto dedicado à pesquisa, desenvolvimento e inovação, valorizamos e incentivamos a pluralidade de pensamentos e vivências, pois isso faz parte do nosso DNA. Nossa missão é promover um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diverso, buscando a equidade de oportunidades e o respeito à diversidade cultural, religiosa, étnico-racial, de gênero, de orientação afetivo-sexual e de pessoas com deficiência, voltado para a defesa e valorização dos direitos humanos. Atualmente, o Atlântico possui uma subárea dedicada à diversidade e inclusão, inserida na área de Pessoas & Cultura. Essa subárea trabalha em colaboração com o Comitê de Diversidade e Inclusão e com os grupos de afinidades, que são compostos por pessoas voluntárias e têm como propósito oferecer um espaço seguro para a troca de vivências, a representatividade e a construção de ações afirmativas.
IMPACTO SOCIAL:
O Comitê de Diversidade e Inclusão do Atlântico investe em ações de voluntariado com foco no impacto social positivo por meio do Grupo de Afinidade de Justiça Social. Who We Are

ENG (engbim.com) is a BIM company that specializes in hands-on, field-focused BIM services. Founded in 2007, we have positioned ourselves as the largest and most experienced BIM production service provider in the United States, having completed 5,000 BIM projects with a dedicated team of over 600 staff members. We provide MEP Modeling, VDC/BIM Management, Laser Scanning, and Scan to BIM services, as well as a comprehensive array of BIM production services to architects, engineers, and owners.

The Role

The BIM Specialist role generally involves covering the modeling of different trades (MEP), depending on your background and expertise, whose extent will depend on the scope of the project (specific zones or entire buildings), and whose quality will go according to clients’ requirements and the services provided by the team you end up joining. This position requires a high level of modeling quality (expertise, technical knowledge, LOD and QAQC capabilities), and more autonomy in its self-management and modeling capabilities (studying whatever's necessary according to each trade). A BIM Specialist saves the client problems, detecting possible conflicts throughout the initial information review and the modeling and coordination phases.

Minimum mandatory requirements include:

  • An excellent level of English is an absolute must, both spoken and written . Aspiring candidates must be able to keep up with fluent conversations both with native and non-native speakers. Candidates without this requirement will NOT be considered .
  • Solid experience modeling HVAC and plumbing in Revit for commercial, industrial, healthcare, and residential construction . This can include things like process piping , ductwork and sheet metal , and mechanical equipment (pumps , AHUs , RTUs , chillers and boilers ), and for plumbing, domestic water , sanitary drainage and gray water , stormwater , medical gases , compressed air lines , pumps , heaters and hangers .
  • Experience coordinating or clash-detecting through Navisworks (Revizto can also be considered but Navisworks will be prioritized), knowledge of BIM coordination, clash report , QAQC and model accuracy .
  • A mechanical or civil engineering bachelors degree (architects could be considered but only if they have extensive experience modeling and coordinating MEP trades themselves).

Specific requirements will vary depending on the position and service. Experience with Level Of Detail (LOD) 400 and projects based in the US , or constructability knowledge related to that country will be a huge differential . Other desirable requirements are:

  • Familiarity with BIM add-ins (e.g., Evolve , SysQue , Fabrication Parts ).
  • Experience in conceptual design / BIM Design assist.
  • AutoCAD Plant 3D knowledge.
  • Dynamo/Python knowledge applied to BIM .
  • On-site/field experience .
  • Ability to produce detailed models, including real-world fittings and connection types .

Please know if you don't have experience working with Revit in formal jobs, it will be hard to consider your profile. Please DON'T apply if you don't have the necessary English level.

title: Criador de Conteúdo e Gerente de Mídias Sociais
description:
Criador de Conteúdo e Gerente de Mídias Sociais

Procuramos uma pessoa criativa, estratégica e orientada a resultados para assumir nossa presença digital como Criador(a) de Conteúdo e Gerente de Mídias Sociais na ALX Recursos Humanos . Essa função é responsável por criar e distribuir conteúdo que aumente a visibilidade da marca, destaque listagens e fechamentos, fortaleça relacionamentos e gere leads através de plataformas como Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube (incluindo Shorts), TikTok, WhatsApp e campanhas de e-mail.

Você será peça central na construção da imagem da corretora e de seus agentes online. A pessoa ideal é tanto contadora de histórias quanto estrategista; capaz de produzir conteúdo envolvente, manter uma rotina de postagens consistente e acompanhar métricas para otimizar os resultados.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e gerenciar um calendário de conteúdo mensal alinhado com os objetivos da marca, cronograma de listagens e sazonalidades.
  • Criar formatos envolventes (Reels, TikToks, Shorts, Stories, depoimentos, bastidores, trechos de blogs, etc.).
  • Escrever legendas persuasivas para posts, destaques de imóveis, atualizações da equipe, resumos de blog e newsletters.
  • Adaptar conteúdo longo (vídeos, eventos, entrevistas) em versões curtas para redes sociais e canais de mensagens.
  • Criar visuais no Canva (ou ferramenta similar) com identidade visual consistente.
  • Produzir ou coordenar peças de marketing como “Novo no Mercado”, “Open House” e “Vendedor”.

Gestão de Redes Sociais

  • Agendar e publicar conteúdo usando ferramentas como Meta Business Suite, Later ou Hootsuite.
  • Monitorar engajamento, responder comentários e mensagens, e cultivar uma comunidade online leal.
  • Acompanhar tendências do setor imobiliário, hashtags, formatos virais e mudanças nos algoritmos.
  • Colaborar com corretores para destacar histórias de sucesso, eventos e marcos.

Campanhas por E-mail e Mensagens Diretas

  • Criar e gerenciar campanhas segmentadas de e-mail via plataformas como Mailchimp ou Flodesk.
  • Utilizar WhatsApp para enviar listas de imóveis, novidades e manter relacionamento com leads, parceiros ou clientes antigos.
  • Manter consistência na mensagem e tom em todos os canais.

Análise, Relatórios e Otimização

  • Acompanhar KPIs como crescimento de seguidores, engajamento, taxas de abertura e cliques, geração de leads e alcance de conteúdo.
  • Sugerir melhorias baseadas em dados e testar variações de conteúdo para melhorar resultados.
  • Realizar testes A/B com diferentes tipos de posts e assuntos de e-mails.

Colaboração e Coordenação

  • Trabalhar próximo à liderança e corretores para alinhar o conteúdo com as metas do negócio.
  • Coordenação com fotógrafos, videomakers e fornecedores externos quando necessário.
  • Oferecer orientações básicas de redes sociais para membros da equipe.

Remuneração e Benefícios

  • Salário base competitivo.
  • Bônus por desempenho com base em engajamento, geração de leads e resultados.
  • Estrutura de trabalho flexível e remota.
  • Oportunidades de crescimento na área de marketing da corretora.
  • Chance de construir um portfólio de marca imobiliária de destaque.

Qualificações

  • Minimo de 2 anos de experiência em criação de conteúdo, mídias sociais ou marketing digital.
  • Excelência na escrita, atenção ao tom de voz e clareza.
  • Habilidade no uso de Canva ou Adobe, edição de vídeo (CapCut, Final Cut, Premiere, InShot, etc.).
  • Domínio de ferramentas de agendamento (Meta Suite, Later, Mailchimp, etc.).
  • Conhecimento sobre geração de leads e nutrição de audiência via conteúdo orgânico.
  • Perfil criativo, detalhista, organizado e com iniciativa.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas contas e prazos remotamente.
  • Bilingue (inglês/português).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em marketing imobiliário ou marcas de serviços profissionais.
  • Habilidades em fotografia ou videomaker.
  • Conhecimento em Meta Ads ou estratégias pagas (não obrigatório, mas desejável).

No nosso backend usamos principalmente aws com node.js e microsserviços orientados a eventos assíncronos. Nosso principal banco de dados é o DynamoDB. title: Keeping Children Safe Seeks a Child Safeguarding Adviser (Brazil Programme Lead)
description:
Keeping Children Safe Seeks a Child Safeguarding Adviser (Brazil Programme Lead)

Summary

This role will lead on the development and implementation of a new child-safeguarding programme in Brazil, as well as contribute to the development of Keeping Children Safe globally.

  • Salary/Grade: GBP £30,000 per annum
  • Duration : Permanent.

Background

Keeping Children Safe sets International Child Safeguarding Standards to help organisations protect children from abuse in organisations across the world.

We are completely independent and guided by the best interests of the child principle in all that we do. We work with people who have been subjected to child abuse, researchers, practitioners, policymakers and leaders to defend children’s right to be safe in all organisations, no matter how big or powerful.

This newly created role in our Standards and Learning team will lead on the development and implementation of a new child-safeguarding programme in Brazil, as well as contribute to the development of Keeping Children Safe globally.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Developing and implementing a new child-safeguarding programme in Brazil.
  • Providing high-quality, technical advice on child safeguarding to Keeping Children Safe members and partners.
  • Providing technical input on child safeguarding to programme development and fundraising proposals.
  • Representing Keeping Children Safe with key stakeholders.
  • Supporting the development and implementation of tools, resources and frameworks for programmatic monitoring, evaluation and learning.
  • Undertaking any other reasonable duty and tasks that may from time-to-time be requested by the line manager consistent with the nature of the job and its level of responsibility.

Person specification:

  • Substantial experience of designing, managing, monitoring and evaluating child-safeguarding initiatives, gained in law enforcement, social work or humanitarian and development organisations.
  • A deep understanding and experience of accompanying organisations in Brazil to embed contextually appropriate child safeguarding measures.
  • Professional level Portuguese and English.
  • Experience of programme development and monitoring, evaluation and learning.
  • Significant track record of delivering training at all levels from community to international.
  • Exceptional facilitation and public speaking skills, ability to inspire others to make significant change.
  • Skilled at identifying and mitigating risks.
  • Proven ability to build, manage and develop key stakeholder, client and donor relationships.
  • Excellent written communication skills including report writing and conducting evaluations.
  • Evidence of Continued Professional Development relevant to the role purpose and level.
  • Able and willing to travel.
  • A proven commitment to child safeguarding, child rights and child participation.
  • A commitment to the vision, aims and approach of the organisation.
  • A commitment to non-discrimination, respect and dignity for all.
  • A team player, able to manage their own workload as well as, work with and support others and deliver to agreed standards and targets.
  • An entrepreneurial, positive, solution-focused approach to work.
  • Integrity with appropriate ethics and behaviours.
  • Experience of leading child-safeguarding investigations.
  • Fluency in Spanish and French.

The Appointment

  • The appointment will be for three days per week.
  • The leave allowance is 25 working days per annum pro rata.
  • In view of the nature of the work involved, any offer of appointment will be conditional upon receipt of satisfactory references and Disclosure and Barring Service/Police checks.

Applications

To apply for this post and to be considered for an interview please apply with your CV and a covering letter addressing each point in the person specification to Helen Carter, Head of Finance and Operations:

Interviews will take place on a rolling basis. The position is open until filled.

Safeguarding statement

Keeping Children Safe has a zero-tolerance approach to any harm, exploitation or abuse of anyone including our staff and stakeholders. Safeguarding forms an intrinsic part of everything that we do. Recruitment to any jobs within KCS will include criminal record checks and the receipt of satisfactory references. Compliance with all our Child Safeguarding Policies and Procedures is mandatory.

Keeping Children Safe values diversity, promotes equality and challenges discrimination we welcome and actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and will select employees based upon their individual merits and abilities, irrespective of a person’s gender, sexual orientation, caring responsibilities, marital status, race, nationality, ethnic background, religion or belief, age or disability.

Aqui na ed, o que mais valorizamos é a nossa cultura. Por isso, iniciamos o nosso processo com o preenchimento de um rápido mapeamento de perfil, aplicado logo após a inscrição. Com esse mapeamento, identificamos o quanto temos em comum no que tange à Cultura Organizacional. Todos que apresentarem o mínimo de Fit Cultural necessário seguem para a próxima etapa. Aqui, valorizamos suas características pessoais, sem importar sua idade, gênero, formação, etc.

Se você topa o desafio, venha fazer parte do nosso time. Estamos focados em qualidade e resultado, com tecnologias de ponta, em um ambiente colaborativo. Pensamos e agimos como um time, desde o problema até a solução. Aqui somos um só, onde o problema de um é o problema de todos.

Criamos softwares, soluções tecnológicas e impulsionamos pessoas, negócios, sociedade e o mundo.

Estamos contratando Analista QA Pleno para fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  1. Criar planos de testes detalhados, incluindo casos de teste, fluxos de trabalho e critérios de aceitação.

  8. Priorizar e acompanhar a resolução de problemas junto à equipe de desenvolvimento.
  9. Fornecer feedback contínuo sobre a qualidade do código e a eficácia das correções.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que amplia as suas chances:

  • Seu fit cultural.

O que não pode faltar:

  • Experiência de pelo menos 3 anos como Analista de QA ou cargos relacionados.
  • Conhecimento sólido em testes de software, incluindo testes funcionais, de regressão, de carga e de performance.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação de testes.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e práticas de DevOps.
  • Habilidades analíticas e atenção aos detalhes para identificar problemas e áreas de melhoria.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa em equipes multidisciplinares.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com testes de APIs usando ferramentas como Postman ou SoapUI.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CI/CD (ex.: Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Experiência com ambientes de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Capacidade de realizar testes de desempenho para avaliar o comportamento sob carga e estresse, usando ferramentas como JMeter, Gatling, LoadRunner, entre outras.
  • Certificações na área de QA ou testes de software.

title: Enterprise Matching Operations Coordinator
description:
Enterprise Matching Operations Coordinator

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As a Matching Operations Coordinator, you will play a pivotal role in facilitating communication between talent and internal team members within our organization. Your primary focus will be to own and maintain effective communication channels with talent while managing various administrative tasks to ensure streamlined operations and job performance. We are seeking individuals who demonstrate exceptional organizational skills, confidence, and possess strong written and verbal communication abilities with a keen attention to detail.

This role requires a clear understanding of Toptal’s operational scope and high-level collaboration across teams to ensure seamless delivery of services. You’ll need the ability to independently manage tasks, contribute to ongoing process improvements, and support strategic initiatives.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary point of contact for communication between talent who are hired on client engagements and internal Toptal stakeholders.
  • Independently manage communication through various channels to ensure seamless interactions and information sharing. Written communication is especially important.
  • Follow-up with talents within assigned accounts to understand project status and to identify and pursue up-sell and cross-sell opportunities, while sharing relevant updates with stakeholders as needed.
  • Manage and execute various tasks and actions associated with assigned accounts to ensure smooth operations and job performance.
  • Maintain constant communication with the team via Slack or Zoom during designated working hours.
  • Assist in account administration items by collaborating with the Finance and Legal teams to ensure compliance with specific account’s requirements.
  • Organize and update process guidelines, making them easily accessible for team reference.
  • Assist in onboarding new team members to ensure a smooth integration process.
  • Support the completion of ad-hoc strategic projects, as needed.

Expectations by Milestone

  • First week : Onboard and integrate into Toptal; familiarize yourself with Toptal’s culture, history and vision; learn team tools, processes and reporting mechanisms; gain proficiency with Toptal’s platform.
  • First month : Understand team processes, policies and content repository; familiarize yourself with various teams at Toptal and their contributions to company success; begin executing tasks with support from other team members.
  • First three months : Independently execute various tasks and actions associated with assigned accounts based on defined processes.
  • First six months : Start making your own contributions to our strategies by having a full grasp of the role, while exercising discretion and independent judgment; be an integral part of the Matching team’s success.
  • First year : Act as a subject matter expert on the Matching Operations Coordinator role.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • At least 2 years of experience in coordination, operations support, or customer support roles.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, as well as perfect grammar and command of the English language. Good communication is at the core of everything we do, and you must be a strong communicator to be able to work successfully with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Excellent organization skills and detail-oriented. You are hyper-organized, know how to work efficiently, and prioritize execution.
  • Proficiency in Google Sheets and Google Docs for data processing and presentation.
  • You should be a self-starter who thrives on accountability and managing your own workflow, tasks, and assigned accounts.
  • You need to be able to follow processes expertly. When faced with limited data, you need to be able to make decisions that follow given guidelines.
  • Adaptability. Our processes and priorities may evolve rapidly. You need to be able to learn and adapt to change quickly.
  • Willingness to collaborate, share knowledge, and learn from teammates.
  • Continuous Improvement. You need to have an eye for continuous improvement and be open to receiving challenging feedback.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

title: Business Services Team Manager
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few roles based in offices.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Business Services Team Manager to lead efficient and effective travel, logistics, event, scheduling, expense policy and administration.

This executive role requires outstanding coordination, planning, decision-making, budgeting, procurement, reporting and management. It is a fast-paced and complex operation in the tech industry.

We coordinate large-scale company events which involve travel for hundreds of people from 80+ countries. We run such events four times a year, a significant investment in our ability to shape culture, teamwork, execution plans and strategy. Our team is responsible for travel procurement and logistics, ensuring that these events run efficiently and safely. Visas, travel complications and unexpected situations make this a complex operation to run efficiently, demanding a rigorous approach and high work ethic in the team.

This team also serves as an independent check on expense claim approval, ensuring fairness and consistency across teams and countries. This requires integrity, transparency and accountability, and a willingness to set and politely defend the same expectations of the most senior and most junior colleagues.

Together these responsibilities amount to tens of millions in operational costs and a significant number of tactical and operational decisions.

Our team also provides traditional 'EA' services for company leads, though they do this across departments and as a consistent service rather than as personal assistants; they schedule meetings, coordinate monthly reports, handle delegated approvals for travel and expenses, work across teams, coordinate with suppliers, and run small projects or initiatives.

Location: Worldwide, home based, except in locations where we have an office, such as London, Taipei and Beijing

Leadership and accountability

This team has a direct impact on every team at Canonical. It is important for them to have excellent judgment and interpersonal skills, the confidence to hold people accountable and defend positions of policy, and the work ethic to move quickly through a large volume of work. It is also essential that the team participate in every company event, from the planning and venue selection stages to scheduling, operations and safety reviews, to ensure that they establish personal relationships with team leaders and can ensure that these events run smoothly.

As a manager, your team would be responsible for

  • Travel approvals, logistics and operations
  • Expense review in line with policies
  • Planning of complex company events four times a year
  • Company offices that provide executive briefing and operational facilities
  • Our global duty of care, health and safety programs with comprehensive policies and practices

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • An undergraduate degree in a technical or business subject
  • Drive, and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Leadership and management skills
  • Demonstrable good judgement in matters involving money, policy and in-person interactions
  • Ability to work in a global, multicultural organisation
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility
  • Responsibility, accountability, thoughtfulness and self-awareness
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel up to four times a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Travel industry experience
  • Project management experience
  • Event management and operations experience
  • Business and corporate administration experience

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

As a Technical Writer or Technical Business Analyst , you will enhance and maintain high-quality internal documentation. This hybrid role sits at the intersection of technology and communication, ensuring that knowledge, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and internal processes are clearly documented, accessible, and continually optimized for cross-functional teams.

The ideal candidate will have strong technical acumen combined with exceptional written communication skills, and a working knowledge of Markdown, Confluence, and Git. How your day-to-day work will look like:

  • Write and edit documentation using Markdown, ensuring clarity and conciseness, while maintaining a well-organized structure in Confluence.
  • Implement and manage Git workflows for documentation versioning and effective collaboration with developers.
  • Oversee and apply knowledge of software development processes, system architectures, APIs, and DevOps tools to enhance technical documentation and support the team.
  • Promote and optimize knowledge management practices that support operational excellence and team efficiency, ensuring key information is accessible and well-structured.

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ Years of experience in technical writing or technical business analysis.
  • Proficiency with Markdown, Confluence, and Git for creating and managing documentation.
  • Strong ability to write, structure, and maintain SOPs, internal guides, knowledge base articles, and system documentation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with attention to detail and consistency.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently and proactively gather information from SMEs.
  • Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

  • Transparency: This process is direct and without intermediaries.

Strategic Workforce Planning Manager (Remote)

Position Mission

The mission of this role is to shape, lead, and embed strategic workforce planning as a core business capability, ensuring the organization has the right talent, skills, and structure to achieve its long-term business objectives. This position exists to influence enterprise strategy through advanced workforce insights, close partnership with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) and senior executives, and proactive solutions to complex workforce challenges.

At this moment, this position does not have direct reports.

Brief Description of the Position

Lead enterprise-wide workforce strategy, partnering with HRBPs and senior leadership to forecast future talent needs, address workforce gaps, and align organizational capability with business priorities. Leverage advanced workforce analytics and predictive insights to influence decision-making, drive talent strategies, and optimize organizational performance.

Activities and Responsibilities

  • Develop, own, and continuously evolve long-term workforce planning strategies aligned with business strategy.
  • Partner with C-suite and senior leadership to ensure workforce planning is a driver of business transformation and growth.
  • Embed workforce planning into enterprise planning cycles (strategic planning, budgeting, operational planning).

Collaboration with HRBPs and Business Leaders

  • Partner closely with HRBPs to integrate workforce planning into talent, succession, and organizational design strategies.
  • Translate business priorities into actionable workforce strategies at enterprise, functional, and regional levels.
  • Facilitate cross-functional alignment between HR, Finance, and business leadership on headcount planning, skills forecasting, and workforce costs.

Advanced Analytics & Workforce Insights

  • Lead advanced analytics, scenario modeling, and predictive forecasting to anticipate future skills, capacity, and talent requirements.
  • Translate complex workforce data into actionable insights for executives and business leaders.
  • Develop and oversee dashboards, reporting frameworks, and workforce models that inform enterprise decisions.

Talent Strategy & Future of Work

  • Identify emerging workforce gaps and design strategies for talent acquisition, reskilling, and retention.
  • Champion workforce agility and capability building in response to digital transformation, automation, and changing business models.
  • Monitor labor market and industry trends to proactively advise leadership on risks and opportunities.

Operational Excellence & Governance

  • Oversee workforce planning tools and ensure consistent, high-quality data inputs across the enterprise.
  • Establish governance frameworks and processes for workforce planning, ensuring compliance with regulatory, privacy, and internal standards.
  • Build organizational capability in workforce planning through training, frameworks, and best practices.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Strategic Workforce Alignment: Degree of alignment between workforce strategies and business priorities.
  • Forecast Accuracy: Precision of workforce projections and predictive models.
  • Executive Adoption: Integration of workforce insights into C-suite and senior-level decision-making.
  • Process Efficiency: Timeliness and cost-effectiveness of workforce planning processes.
  • Talent Readiness Metrics: Availability of critical skills and talent pipelines to meet business needs.

Main Opportunities and Decisions

  • This role operates at the intersection of business strategy, HR strategy, and advanced analytics . Key challenges include anticipating disruptive workforce shifts, balancing cost efficiency with capability growth, and influencing executive priorities with data-driven insights. This position represents a transformational leadership opportunity —guiding the organization to be future-ready, agile, and resilient in a competitive and evolving environment.

Key Relationships, Stakeholders & Interfaces (External & Internal):

  • Business Leaders
  • HR Business Partners
  • Finance and Controller
  • HR BBS
  • IT

Knowledge and Technical Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Finance or a related field; master’s preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in strategic workforce planning, HR strategy/consulting, partnering closely with HRBPs and Finance to align talent plans with business goals.
  • Advanced analytical and forecasting skills (supply/demand, scenario modeling).
  • Excellent executive communication and stakeholder influence skills.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple business portfolios and deliverables simultaneously in a matrixed environment.
  • Strong project/program management and facilitation skills (workshop, governance, roadmaps) with a track record of driving adoption.
  • Strong attention to detail and data integrity; experienced handling confidential information and adhering to compliance standards.

Vaga temporária - contrato de 180 dias. Este especialista iniciante auxilia no desenvolvimento e na implementação de programas e intervenções de desenvolvimento infantil voltado à área da saúde primária. O especialista geralmente fornece conhecimentos básicos que são úteis em áreas holísticas de desenvolvimento infantil. Neste nível de carreira, ainda pode estar aprendendo e auxiliando profissionais mais experientes e geralmente trabalha sob a orientação de seu supervisor ou de um especialista mais experiente, ou como membro de uma equipe em projetos maiores.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como defensor das crianças, compreender o mandato de Cristo de proteger as crianças. Comprometer-se e priorizar as considerações de proteção infantil em todas as tomadas de decisão, tarefas e atividades em todo o ministério. Cumprir todas as expectativas comportamentais da Declaração de Compromisso com a Proteção Infantil e do Código de Conduta da Compassion. Relatar quaisquer preocupações de abuso, negligência ou exploração de crianças por meio do processo interno de denúncias da Compassion e apoiar adequadamente as respostas a incidentes, caso ocorram.
  • Contribui para o trabalho dos facilitadores de parceria e da equipe e gerentes multifuncionais dentro de uma área de especialidade designada. Apoia o aprendizado e o aprimoramento da comunidade de desenvolvimento infantil entre a equipe e outras partes interessadas. Auxilia os líderes da comunidade a promover a transformação local. Também pode contribuir para iniciativas especiais.
  • Conforme orientado, ajuda a entregar a programação dentro da área de saúde. Consolida os dados locais para identificar lacunas e padrões comuns. Mantém e apoia a implementação da estratégia de saúde da família.
  • Apoia o desenvolvimento e a implementação contínuos do projeto do programa local, em alinhamento com os objetivos globais.
  • Fornece informações à administração e outros tomadores de decisão sobre a alocação de recursos adequados.
  • Auxilia na implementação e monitora estratégias e intervenções holísticas específicas para o desenvolvimento infantil. Trabalha com facilitadores de parcerias, garantindo que os registros de intervenção, relatórios e outras documentações sejam precisos, completos e entregues às partes interessadas apropriadas.
  • Ajuda a preparar dados, relatórios e conclusões para apoiar a administração e as principais partes interessadas na melhoria das iniciativas do programa, intervenções e resultados infantis.
  • Ajuda a manter o Programa de Sobrevivência Infantil e pode monitorar os orçamentos dele, conforme designado. Ajuda a fornecer apoio curricular e materiais de treinamento às mães com base em programas estabelecidos.
